question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

GBD IDF KFH MHJ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9b4ecba97fe294de69383e3af26a89598bba6e5fd04e4582cca39c805497f0c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/facb055eeb5a9be2dd542121f59f04f65efe6bf4463b11ec879cc105aa3de3bd.png] 

So, **'OJL' **will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
